intent.raw: invoke refresh the current work pack with this steps
intent.objective: Refresh the split Craft Consultation API Work Pack so a verified WaveDB 0.15.9 package is re-ingested and fresh-process verified before dependency pinning and read-only API construction.
intent.operator_sentence: Apply only the four declared split Work Pack runtime-plan deltas; preserve blocked execution and all authority boundaries.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The governed Invoke route is one sequential local refresh. One AGENTS.md-required bounded read-only helper supplied a delta critique outside the governed dispatch composition and is recorded separately.

agents.capability_target: Craft Consultation API split Work Pack runtime order

steps.name: Resolve the exact current split Work Pack
stop_conditions: block if current Work Pack resolution is ambiguous or Inventory lookup readiness fails

steps.name: Bind source evidence and refresh obligations
stop_conditions: block unless every refresh obligation has exact selector-level coverage

steps.name: Stage and validate the exact material package

inputs.ref: direct user approval for the declared four-path refresh scope

stop_conditions: block unless approval scope, changes, target inventory, dependencies, owner boundary, and publication boundary pass exactly

steps.name: Apply, validate, and report the refresh
stop_conditions: block on target drift, failed exact-output comparison, stale dependency order, widened allowed routes, Craft/implementation mutation, or validation failure

gates.condition: strict context coverage passes for the four exact targets and three runtime receipts
direct-user apply approval, material changes, and target inventory normalize to exactly the same four private internal paths
material validator, handoff resolver, target hash checks, dependency-order assertions, JSON checks, and scoped whitespace checks pass
refresh does not mutate Craft ledgers, WaveDB attempts, implementation code, allowed routes, publication, deployment, or production state

boundaries.contract: Inventory supplies discovery selectors only; direct work-pack and receipt bytes decide the refresh.
Only the four declared private internal planning paths may be updated after a ready material handoff.
0.15.9 evidence opens a planned re-ingestion predecessor only; it does not prove Craft snapshot or API integration.

authority.lifecycle: invoke owns refresh authoring; the Craft Consultation API plan owner owns the target artifacts
authority.execution: none in this refresh; future Task Session only after a separate execution request and admission
authority.validation: dispatch-spec plus Invoke material validators and live target checks
authority.memory: Inventory and memory are discovery only
authority.promotion: separate Craft, implementation, publication, deployment, and production owners

state_namespaces.write_policy: refresh evidence plus four exact planning targets only

promotion_splits.source: WaveDB 0.15.9 local diagnostic and refreshed plan
promotion_splits.target: Craft snapshot, API implementation, deployment, or production
promotion_splits.rule: requires later owner-routed execution and receipts; never inferred from refresh

promotion_guardrails: Craft ledger YAML remains source authority and unchanged.
The existing 0.15.8 Craft snapshot and all prior attempts remain immutable evidence.
The refreshed Work Pack remains blocked with an empty allowed-route projection.
No API package, dependency, server, publication, deployment, or production state is created by this refresh.
